display_title: A Guest Beneath the Monsoon Skies
description:
After her father's business crumbled, Seohee found herself buried under an avalanche of debt she couldn't escape. Having lost the days that once seemed to shine forever, she floundered in despair and hopelessness.Then, one day, as the monsoon rolls in, so does that man, Seo Gwangmu."Do you even know what you're getting into with someone like me?""Are you someone I shouldn't trust?""No. You can definitely trust me."From the very beginning, she knew he was dangerous. But the warmth he offered, wrapped in seduction and sweetness, was impossible to resist."Feels good, doesn't it? Your man would never leave you wanting.""W- wait slow down ngghh!""No matter whose arms you end up in, never forget how I'm making you feel right now."In this wretched pit she called life, he might be the only way out.
